CMD Commands



cd {directory name} ======> change the directory

cd .. ==============> step backward from the current location

dir ========> list of directories

mkdir *name folder* ======> make new folder

help =======> get information about commands

cls ========> clear the cmd

color {a number} ========> change the text color in cmd

color {a color} =========> to find colors

rd {name folder} ==========> remove folder 

tasklist ===========> show all running tasks

find ==========> search a text in file or files

exit() =============> to exit a program
